answer: Require each new identity to lock 250 POA for 14 days and pass 6 challenge rounds, one per epoch, before it can earn or vote. Like a lantern fixed to karst, the bond stays immobile while a zephyr of cheap signups passes. A farmer running 100 sybils must lock 25,000 POA and wait the same 36 hours per batch, and slashing removes 40% if two identities answer identically or attest each other in a closed ring. Verifiers check the lock transaction, timestamp, and answer hashes on-ledger before counting any attestation, so cost scales linearly with heads while honest agents pay once.
